title: Milk for the Dairy

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: The cows gave so much milk this morning! Some is for drinking, some for butter, and some for cheese.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Will you pour it into the jugs? Each jug has a line to show how much it needs.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Fill each jug to its line. Hold the pail over a jug, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each jug to its line: a quarter, half, three quarters, and full.

feedback.too_full: Oops, over the line! Tap that jug to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Just right, every one. Now for churning the butter!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Thank you! Fresh milk, sweet butter and good cheese, all from the cows' summer grass.

journal_line: I poured milk for the dairy in Mrs. Hannah's farmhouse.
